widgets-desc:
Waxay u oggolaanaysaa maamulayaasha wiki-ga inay ku daraan widgets qaab xor ah wiki-ga iyagoo wax ka beddelaya bogagga ku jira namespace-ka {{ns:widget}}.

Widgets-ka ay bulshada soo kordhisay waxaa laga heli karaa [http://www.mediawikiwidgets.org/Main_Page MediaWikiWidgets.org]
action-editwidgets: Abuur oo wax ka beddel widgets
right-editwidgets: Abuur oo wax ka beddel [https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Special:MyLanguage/Extension:Widgets widgets] ku jira meel-magac {{ns:widget}}
grant-editwidgets: Abuur oo wax ka beddel widgets
widgets-config-useflaggedrevs: U dhig tan true si aad u isticmaasho nooca xasilloon ee kordhinta FlaggedRevs ee amniga widget-ka
widgets-config-compiledir: U deji gal caadi ah oo lagu kaydiyo tusmada la isku soo ururiyay
widgets-config-autoregistercspsources: Marka $wgCSPHeader la hawlgeliyo, si otomaatig ah ugu oggolow siyaasadda Content-Security-Policy martigeliyeyaasha dibadda ee uu tixraacayo koodhka isha widget-ku (qoraallada, xaashiyaha qaabeynta, looxyada iyo warbaahinta). Martigeliyeyaasha ka yimaadda xuduudaha widget-ka lama oggola.
widgets-config-cspsources: Ilaha dheeraadka ah ee Content-Security-Policy ee loo oggol yahay bogagga ay ku jiraan widget-yadu, oo ah khariidad ka socota magaca tilmaamaha (tusaale ahaan connect-src ama font-src) una socota liiska ilaha.Tilmaamaha aan ahayn script-src iyo style-src waxaa lagu daraa default-src. U isticmaal tan khayraadka ay widget-yadu soo dejiyaan inta ay shaqaynayaan oo aan laga ogaan karin calaamadayntooda
